svg.title: Textual memory: one profile, rewritten
svg.desc: Textual memory's architecture, with the running example. Writing: after each session, one LLM call reads the current profile and the new session and writes the whole profile again. Memory: one text profile under four headings, 153 words after two sessions; the diet line now says pescatarian and keeps the old diet as 'previously'. Reading: no search; the whole profile goes into the prompt, and the answer covers every constraint.
